# Image Compressor

Image Compressor is a browser-based tool for reducing image file size before publishing or sharing.

Canonical URL: https://compress.imageprivacy.org/

## Features

- Compress images to JPEG or WebP
- Choose output quality
- Limit maximum width
- Compare original and output file size
- Process files locally in the browser

## Recommended workflow

Choose a target width, lower quality gradually, compare the preview with the original, and confirm important details remain readable. Compression reduces file size but does not hide visible private information.

## Privacy model

The selected image is re-encoded in the browser. Exporting creates a metadata-light public copy.
